legal.privacy.section1_text: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, post in the community, collect a stamp, order from the merch shop or contact us. fer.hero_title: Grow Your Escape Room Business with
fer.hero_subtitle: The platform that brings players to your escape room. Showcase your rooms, send players to your own site to book, and keep them coming back with stamps, the community and merch.
fer.features_subtitle: From showcasing your rooms to stamps and merch, you get every tool to reach more players.
fer.feat_booking_desc: Accept bookings 24/7 through our widget on your website. Manage time slots, capacity, and availability with ease. Players can book directly, reducing phone calls and manual work.
fer.feat_widget_desc: Add our booking widget to your existing website with a single line of code. Fully themed to match your brand. Works on any website platform — WordPress, Wix, custom, etc.
fer.feat_dashboard_desc: A complete control center to manage rooms, track bookings, monitor revenue, and view analytics. Everything in one place, accessible from any device.
fer.feat_analytics_desc: See how many players tap "Book on Their Site" for each room and day, and how many took a stamp.
fer.feat_photos_desc: Capture team photos after each game and share them instantly. Players receive their photos via a unique link — a great way to boost social sharing and word-of-mouth.
fer.feat_listing_desc: Your rooms are listed on unlocked.gr where thousands of escape room fans discover new experiences. Get found by players searching by location, theme, or difficulty.
fer.feat_payments_desc: Take full payments or deposits online, straight into your own Stripe or Viva account. Players can still choose to pay on arrival if you allow it.
fer.feat_website_desc: Need a website? Our team builds professional, SEO-optimized websites tailored for escape rooms. Mobile-friendly, fast, and designed to convert visitors into bookers.
fer.feat_booknow_desc: Each room's booking button sends players straight to your own site or booking system. No middleman.
fer.feat_passport_desc: Show the QR at the end of the game and every player gets your room's stamp in their passport. Stamps open floors in the Haunted Tower, so they bring players back.
fer.feat_community_desc: Players share their escapes, photos and your rooms in the UNLOCKED community, and bring their friends.
fer.feat_merch_desc: Sell t-shirts, mugs and souvenirs of your rooms. Payments go straight to your own account.
fer.pricing_subtitle: Pay per booking, or one flat price. No hidden fees, no surprises.
fer.how_subtitle: Four simple steps to get your escape room on UNLOCKED.
fer.how_step1_desc: Register your company on business.unlocked.gr. It takes less than 2 minutes.
fer.how_step2_desc: Set up your rooms with descriptions, photos, difficulty levels and the booking link of your own site.
fer.how_step3_desc: At the end of every game, show the UNLOCKED QR: each player gets your room's stamp in their passport.
fer.how_step4_desc: See how many players head to your site, sell merch and reach new players through the community.
fer.faq1_a: For packages and prices, contact us and we will tell you what suits your escape room.
fer.faq2_q: How do players book my rooms?
fer.faq2_a: On each room's page, players tap "Book on Their Site" and go to the booking link you set: your own website or booking system. If you have none, your phone number is shown instead.
fer.faq3_q: Can I keep my own booking system?
fer.faq3_a: Of course. UNLOCKED does not take bookings or payments for rooms: it sends players to your own site, where they book and pay as always.
fer.faq4_a: At the end of every game you show a QR from your company dashboard. Each player scans it and gets your room's stamp in their passport, which opens floors and gifts in the Haunted Tower game. So players want to come back for more rooms.
fer.faq5_q: How long does the review process take?
fer.faq5_a: After you register, our team reviews your application. This usually takes 1-2 working days. You will get an email as soon as you are approved.
fer.faq6_a: Yes. From your company dashboard you add products to the UNLOCKED shop. Payments go straight to your own Stripe or Viva account, and you handle pickup or shipping.
fer.faq7_q: Do you build websites for escape rooms?
fer.faq7_a: Yes! We offer professional website development from €500. Our sites are built for escape rooms: fast, mobile-friendly, SEO-optimized and linked with UNLOCKED.
fer.faq8_q: What kind of support do you offer?
fer.faq8_a: Every partner gets email support at hello@unlocked.gr.
fer.cta_subtitle: Join UNLOCKED today and start reaching more players, giving out stamps and building a community around your rooms.

legal.terms.merch_text:
The UNLOCKED Shop sells two kinds of goods. UNLOCKED Official items are sold and shipped by UNLOCKED. Escape room items are sold by that escape room, which is the seller: it takes the payment into its own account and handles pickup, shipping, returns and refunds. UNLOCKED only provides the shop.

Prices include any Premium discount shown at checkout. Orders paid online are confirmed once the payment provider confirms the payment. Orders reserved for pay at pickup are paid at the venue and may be cancelled by you before you collect them.

If you live in the EU, you can withdraw from an order for shipped goods within 14 days of delivery without giving a reason, and return the goods unused. Contact the seller shown on your order. Items you collect in person can be returned under the seller’s own policy and your local consumer law. Personalised items and opened sealed goods may not be returnable.

Premium shop perks (discounts, free shipping, early drops, members-only items and the yearly welcome gift) apply while your membership is active and may change. The welcome gift is given once per member, with the first UNLOCKED Official order.
